1.consolidated_definition: Apelativo familiar y cariñoso que se aplica a los niños precoces, graciosos, simpáticos y despiertos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Affectionate term used to describe precocious, charming, and lively children who exhibit exceptional wit and intelligence from an early age.
